resourceProviders.name: Texas Advanced Computing Center (TACC)
resourceProviders.description: TACC provides large-scale computing resources for open science research.

systems.name: Frontera
systems.description: Deployed in June 2019, Frontera is the fastest supercomputer on a university campus in the U.S.

systems.name: Stampede3
systems.description: Stampede3 is the newest strategic resource for the nation's open science community since entering full production in 2024.

systems.name: Lonestar6
systems.description: Supporting Texas researchers with a balanced set of resources to support simulation, data analysis, visualization, and machine learning.

resourceProviders.name: San Diego Supercomputer Center (SDSC)
resourceProviders.description: SDSC operates HPC systems designed for science gateways.

systems.name: Expanse
systems.description: Expanse supports SDSC's vision of “Computing without Boundaries” by increasing the capacity and performance for thousands of users of batch-oriented and science gateway computing.

systems.name: Voyager
systems.description: Voyager is an innovative AI system designed specifically for science and engineering research at scale.

resourceProviders.name: Jetstream2
resourceProviders.description: Jetstream2 makes cutting-edge high-performance computing and software easy to use for research regardless of your project's scale.

systems.name: Jetstream2 Main
systems.description: Jetstream2 is a flexible, user-friendly cloud computing environment available to US-based researchers and educators at no cost.

systems.name: Pitzer
systems.description: A 10,560-core Dell Intel Gold 6148 + 19,104-core Dual Intel Xeon 8268 machine.
